answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 17 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 200 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. What carries the summit here is verification, the oasis of cost is what stops the farm, and the comet of the record keeps every claim checkable.
